description: "The Opening Heavens" by Joseph Bates is a theological publication written in the mid-19th century. This book delves into the interpretations of biblical prophecies and apostolic teachings concerning the nature of the heavens, the anticipated second coming of Jesus Christ, and the ultimate establishment of the New Jerusalem.
